title: Jellyfish Pool Party
description: A joyful plus-size Black woman in a purple floral swimsuit dances in a glowing pool with jellyfish, raising her arm with a big smile. A bearded man in tactical vest and Hawaiian shorts stands beside her holding a pineapple drink, both surrounded by floating lanterns, rain, and comic panels referencing Squidward and a 'squidward jumps the party' meme.
prompt: A vibrant nighttime pool party scene with a happy plus-size Black woman with long blonde hair wearing a purple and yellow floral one-piece swimsuit dancing in glowing water filled with bioluminescent jellyfish, a bearded man with long dark hair wearing a black tactical vest and Hawaiian shorts standing next to her holding a pineapple drink, raining with colorful hanging lanterns above, small comic panels floating in the corner showing Squidward and party scenes, whimsical cartoon style, detailed lighting
